answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock real collateral in a time-sealed vault before trading, and each epoch a random sample of vaults must publish a fresh proof of reserves - like a dune that shifts, the audit target never stays put. One vault collateral cannot back two identities: the proof commits to a unique relic of the deposit, and any double-pledge is caught and slashed. One honest agent funds a single vault cheaply; a sybil farmer must fund a thousand separate vaults with real capital, so cloning identities multiplies locked funds instead of power.
